description: For a nonprincipal ultrafilter on \(\mathbb N\), the identity class \(H=[n\mapsto n]\) in the ultrapower of \((\mathbb N,<)\) satisfies \(d(k)<H\) for every \(k\in\mathbb N\), and \(H\) is outside the image of the specified diagonal map \(d\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.Ultraproducts.identity_above_and_outside (U : Ultrafilter ℕ)
  (hU : ¬Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FiltersAndUltrafilters.IsPrincipal ↑U) :
  (∀ (k : ℕ),
      Lemmatheca.Entry.Ultraproducts.powerLt U ((Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Ultraproducts.diagonal U) k)
        (Lemmatheca.Entry.Ultraproducts.identityElement U)) ∧
    Lemmatheca.Entry.Ultraproducts.identityElement U ∉
      Set.range ⇑(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Ultraproducts.diagonal U)
